title: [Main]-Incident 51000001072719 : [BC-IN][28.1] Wrong TDS amount is being reflected on the TDS Entries page while posting a Purchase Invoice against a foreign (NRI) vendor.
summary: Fixed TDS amount currency conversion for foreign vendors without PAN under concessional codes by adding the missing Currency Code field mapping in the tax engine use case configuration.
key_points: TDS Entry amounts are now correctly converted from foreign currency to local currency (INR) for NRI vendors without PAN
Currency Code field mapping was added to the TDS Entry insert record in the tax engine configuration
The fix aligns the non-PAN concessional code use case with other working NRI vendor scenarios
